definitions.explanation: A small pocket of fluid that forms under the skin, typically caused by burns, friction, or sunburn. A very common everyday health term in Japanese.

examples.japanese: ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{水|みず}ぶくれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I got a blister on my foot.

examples.japanese: やけど⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{水|みず}ぶくれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出来|でき}てしまった。
examples.english: I ended up getting a blister from a burn.

examples.japanese: {水|みず}ぶくれ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{潰|つぶ}す→潰す：00410_tsubusu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{感染|かんせん}する→感染する：26931_kansensuru⟧{恐|おそ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{触|さわ}らない→触る：00808_sawaru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: Popping a blister can lead to infection, so it's better not to touch it yourself.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧ (water) and ぶくれ (swelling, from ⟦{膨|ふく}れる→膨れる：25246_fukureru⟧). Refers to a fluid-filled blister on the skin caused by burns, friction, or skin conditions. Very common in everyday health vocabulary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水|みず}ぶくれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: to get a blister
- {水|みず}ぶくれ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{潰|つぶ}す→潰す：00410_tsubusu⟧: to pop a blister
- {水|みず}ぶくれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{破|やぶ}れる→破れる：02322_yabureru⟧: a blister bursts

CAUSES:
- や⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧ (burn)
- {靴|くつ}ずれ (shoe friction)
- ⟦{日焼|ひや}け→日焼け：15469_hiyake⟧ (sunburn)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦マメ→マメ：22357_mame⟧ — callus or blister (from friction, often on hands)
- {火|ひ}ぶくれ — burn blister (specifically from heat)
- {腫|は}れ — swelling (more general)
